messages:
Priya: Quick sync for contractor Day 1 on Tue 9am PT — welcome Marco! Two logistic items: I-9 verification (contractor exception flow) and international laptop shipment through customs. Can you confirm you can sign the I-9 remotely via notary?
Marco: Hi! Im in Vancouver and can do a local notary on Mon. Also need the laptop sent there; any customs paperwork from Redwood?
IT-Logistics: We can ship to Canada but need a commercial invoice + proof of employment letter for customs. Marco, please DM shipping address and preferred courier. Imaging will occur after receipt; allow 48h.
Priya: For the I-9 contractor path we have a remote authorized-rep template. If you have a notary, upload notarized Section 1/2 scans to the secure HR intake link. We'll note contractor status for tax docs (W-9 vs 1099).
bg-vendor: Background check: international police cert for Canada is fine; we just need ID and one local reference. If notary provides business card + stamp, that helps. Expect 3-5 biz days.
Marco: Will the pending BG hold up benefits orientation or contractor pay setup?
Priya: Benefits intro is optional for contractors; payroll setup (payrate + banking) requires completed tax forms and signed offer. BG pending won't stop bank setup but payroll activation waits until tax docs verified.
IT-Logistics: We'll generate customs docs once address received. If you need macOS laptop with MDM, confirm and we'll apply a Canada-specific power adapter and shipment labeling.
Priya: Checklist for you: I-9 via notary + upload, DM shipping address to IT-Logistics, email one local reference to bg-vendor, submit banking and tax form to payroll portal. We'll send calendar invites for orientation 9am PT and benefits/payroll 2pm PT.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Upload ID and notary scans 24h before start date to avoid access delays.
Marco: Thanks — sending address and notary appointment details in DM now. Appreciate the clear checklist!
